title: Set seat and mirrors before driving
body: Stop safely before seat/mirror adjustment. For DSM/DCM, memory, relaxation or reverse tilt, see their manuals. No latch, mirror-position or blind-spot sensor is connected.

steps.title: Stop and clear
steps.body: Before departure, clear seat travel and footwell. Check rear occupants and fitted controls.
official_cautions: Never adjust seats/mirrors or fold mirrors while driving: distraction risks a crash.
No objects under seats/feet: pedal blockage or injury. Do not reach into mechanisms.
No lighters on floor/between seats: movement may release gas and cause fire.
Never leave children alone; powered seats work even with power off.

steps.title: Adjust seat
steps.body: Manual: lift front lever, slide, release and rock to check locking. For backrest, lean forward, lift outer lever, adjust, release; check lever return/locking. Powered: use position/backrest switch; release when set.
official_cautions: Keep hands clear of moving parts/under-seat mechanisms; beware rails/latches and rear occupants, especially children.
Clear backrest obstructions; verify seat/backrest locking.
Do not force powered switches or use two or more at once; release after adjustment to prevent motor/electrical damage.
Avoid powered adjustment with power off: battery drain.
If fitted, protect lumbar support from sharp items; stop when it cannot extend further.

steps.title: Posture
steps.body: Sit fully back/upright: knee slightly bent at full brake; wrist at farthest wheel rim. Head-restraint centre at ear tops, close to head. Shoulder belt over chest; lap belt over pelvis.
official_cautions: Keep as far from wheel as control allows: airbag deployment too close can be fatal.
Do not recline too far or sit on folded seats: loss of belt protection or sliding under it, compressing abdomen/neck, risks serious injury or death.
Seat cushions may reduce friction: sliding under the belt in a crash/sudden stop can cause serious injury.
Never drive without head restraint or adjust it while driving. Avoid finger trapping at pole guides; attach no accessories.
Seat forward + backrest tilted forward may make head restraint hit nearby parts (e.g. sun visor).

steps.title: Interior mirror
steps.body: Centre rear-window view. Day/night: set angle in day position before departure. If ECM, keep front/rear light sensors clear.
official_cautions: No items above seat height: blocked rear view and forward-thrown objects in a crash/sudden stop.
Do not modify/add wide mirror or remove/refit it: collision injury, damage or vibration.
Night position cuts glare but reduces mirror clarity.

steps.title: Exterior mirrors
steps.body: At ACC/ON/running, select L(driver)/R(passenger) and use switch. Fold/unfold by button. Use interior mirror too for following-vehicle distance.
official_cautions: Convex mirrors: objects are much closer than they appear.
Release at limit: motor keeps running. Do not adjust angle/fold/unfold by hand.
If frozen, never force movement/folding or scrape ice. Use de-icer or thaw in a warm place.
Excess folding with power off can drain battery.
